title: Ancient South American 'bird' models resembling airplanes

tellings.quote: you know, you can take some of the um models of so-called birds >> from South America.

plain: Some small ancient models from South America that are usually called birds look like airplanes. A doctor who worked with NASA, Greg Rogers, brings them up in passing with Michels as an example, without naming a source. He seems to suggest that ancient people may have seen or known about flying machines.
